people.name: Aijalon
people.line: A Levitical city in Dan, site of Joshua's miracle.

people.name: Elon
people.line: A judge of Israel from the tribe of Zebulun.

people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
translations.bsb: Then Elon the Zebulunite died, and he was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
translations.kjv: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.
translations.asv: And Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
